deviations.what: The nodes.culture.dev tunnel token is sealed as a hidden secret in thor's grant store (NODES_CULTURE_DEV_TUNNEL_TOKEN) and cloudflared-nodes.service execs through 'grant run --inject TUNNEL_TOKEN=...' instead of reading TUNNEL_TOKEN_FILE from a 0600 file; deploy/prod/cloudflared-nodes.service and docs/operations/nodes-culture-dev.md step 3 change accordingly, which widens the spec's non-goal c11 (no deploy/ changes) by one unit file and one doc
deviations.reason: operator decision 2026-09-02: no plaintext token on disk; grant (the renamed shushu secrets manager) is installed on thor and spark, hidden secrets are consumable only via grant run, and rotation becomes one grant set
